summary_1line: With the rains ended, Rama laments Sita amid autumn’s beauty and grows angry that Sugriva delays sending the monkey armies to search for her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama sits on a golden mountain ridge under a clear autumn moon, gazing sadly across forests while cranes call in the distance.
A calm lake filled with blooming lotuses holds a single sleeping swan beneath a bright full moon and countless stars.
Lakshmana stands beside the sorrowful Rama on the mountain slope as the sky clears after the monsoon and white geese fly across the horizon.
